children: Mount Logan Capital, through subsidiary Mount Logan Management, entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire the advisory business related to AMCLX from Alternative Fund Advisors. At closing, Mount Logan Management is expected to become AMCLX’s investment manager and the fund’s board will be reconstituted, subject to board, shareholder and other approvals. Consideration includes up to $4.6 million, with $300,000 at closing, deferred installments over three years subject to asset-level adjustments, and 40% of AMCLX management and incentive fees for five years, subject to suspension triggers.
: Asset purchase agreement for AMCLX advisory business and management transition
